# Temporal_Topology_Mapping

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A technique for representing time-varying network states as topological features for neuromorphic interpretation. Allows neuromorphic systems to process real-time network dynamics, enabling predictive and adaptive network management.
